(()=>{const d=document.querySelector('.industry-workbench'); if(!d) return 'NO WORKBENCH'; d.open=true; d.scrollIntoView(); return 'workbench opened';})()

(()=>{const s=document.querySelector('.industry-picker select'); const set=Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(window.HTMLSelectElement.prototype,'value').set; set.call(s,'quantity-surveying'); s.dispatchEvent(new Event('change',{bubbles:true})); return 'selected '+s.value;})()

(()=>{const b=Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('button')).filter(x=>x.textContent.trim()==='Add classification'); if(!b.length) return 'NO ADD CLASSIFICATION'; b[0].click(); b[0].click(); return 'added 2 classifications';})()

(()=>{const setV=(el,v)=>{const set=Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(window.HTMLInputElement.prototype,'value').set; set.call(el,v); el.dispatchEvent(new Event('input',{bubbles:true}));}; const L=Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('.industry-form label')); const find=t=>L.find(l=>l.textContent.trim().startsWith(t)); const h=find('Hierarchy name'); const hr=find('Hierarchy revision'); if(h) setV(h.querySelector('input'),'QA hierarchy'); if(hr) setV(hr.querySelector('input'),'B'); const c1=find('Classification code 1'), l1=find('Classification label 1'), c2=find('Classification code 2'), l2=find('Classification label 2'); if(c1) setV(c1.querySelector('input'),'Building'); if(l1) setV(l1.querySelector('input'),'Whole building'); if(c2) setV(c2.querySelector('input'),'Walls'); if(l2) setV(l2.querySelector('input'),'Wall finish'); return 'hierarchy filled';})()

(()=>{const L=Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('.industry-form label')); const p2=L.find(l=>l.textContent.trim().startsWith('Parent classification 2')); if(!p2) return 'NO PARENT 2'; const s=p2.querySelector('select'); const opt=Array.from(s.options).find(o=>o.textContent.includes('Building')); if(!opt) return 'NO BUILDING OPTION: '+Array.from(s.options).map(o=>o.textContent).join('|'); const set=Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(window.HTMLSelectElement.prototype,'value').set; set.call(s,opt.value); s.dispatchEvent(new Event('change',{bubbles:true})); return 'Walls parented to Building';})()

(()=>{const b=Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('button')).filter(x=>x.textContent.trim()==='Add quantity'); if(!b.length) return 'NO ADD QUANTITY'; for(let i=0;i<4;i++) b[0].click(); return 'added 4 quantity rows';})()

(()=>{const setV=(el,v)=>{const set=Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(window.HTMLInputElement.prototype,'value').set; set.call(el,v); el.dispatchEvent(new Event('input',{bubbles:true}));}; const L=Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('.industry-form label')); const find=t=>L.find(l=>l.textContent.trim().startsWith(t)); const rows=[['a','0.1','m2'],['b','0.2','m2'],['c','3','lm'],['d','4','m2']]; rows.forEach((r,i)=>{const n=i+1; const ref=find('Item reference '+n), q=find('Quantity '+n), u=find('Unit '+n); if(ref) setV(ref.querySelector('input'),r[0]); if(q) setV(q.querySelector('input'),r[1]); if(u) setV(u.querySelector('input'),r[2]);}); return 'filled 4 items';})()

(()=>{const L=Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('.industry-form label')); const find=t=>L.find(l=>l.textContent.trim().startsWith(t)); const pick=(n,code)=>{const lab=find('Assign item '+n); if(!lab) return 'no assign '+n; const s=lab.querySelector('select'); const opt=Array.from(s.options).find(o=>o.textContent.includes(code)); if(!opt) return 'no opt '+code; const set=Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(window.HTMLSelectElement.prototype,'value').set; set.call(s,opt.value); s.dispatchEvent(new Event('change',{bubbles:true})); return 'ok';}; const r1=pick(1,'Building'); const r2=pick(2,'Walls'); const r3=pick(3,'Walls'); return 'a->Building:'+r1+' b->Walls:'+r2+' c->Walls:'+r3+' (d left unassigned)';})()

(()=>{const b=Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('button')).find(x=>x.textContent.trim()==='Calculate classification'); if(!b) return 'NO CALC'; if(b.disabled) return 'CALC DISABLED'; b.click(); return 'calculated';})()

(()=>{const L=Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('.industry-result label')); const s=L.find(l=>l.textContent.trim().startsWith('Show quantities')).querySelector('select'); const set=Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(window.HTMLSelectElement.prototype,'value').set; set.call(s,'classified'); s.dispatchEvent(new Event('change',{bubbles:true})); return 'filter=classified';})()

(()=>{const L=Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('.industry-result label')); const s=L.find(l=>l.textContent.trim().startsWith('Show quantities')).querySelector('select'); const set=Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(window.HTMLSelectElement.prototype,'value').set; set.call(s,'unassigned'); s.dispatchEvent(new Event('change',{bubbles:true})); return 'filter=unassigned';})()

(()=>{const t=document.querySelectorAll('.industry-result table'); const shown=t[1]; const L=Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('.industry-result label')); const branch=L.find(l=>l.textContent.trim().startsWith('Classification branch')).querySelector('select'); const rows=Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('.industry-result table')).pop().querySelectorAll('tbody tr'); return JSON.stringify({shownCaption:shown.querySelector('caption').textContent,branchDisabled:branch.disabled,branchValue:branch.value,itemRows:Array.from(rows).map(r=>r.querySelector('th')?.textContent)});})()

(()=>{const L=Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('.industry-result label')); const a=L.find(l=>l.textContent.trim().startsWith('Show quantities')).querySelector('select'); const set=Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(window.HTMLSelectElement.prototype,'value').set; set.call(a,'all'); a.dispatchEvent(new Event('change',{bubbles:true})); return 'filter=all';})()

(()=>{const L=Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('.industry-result label')); const b=L.find(l=>l.textContent.trim().startsWith('Classification branch')).querySelector('select'); const opt=Array.from(b.options).find(o=>o.textContent.includes('Walls')); if(!opt) return 'NO WALLS OPT: '+Array.from(b.options).map(o=>o.textContent).join('|'); const set=Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(window.HTMLSelectElement.prototype,'value').set; set.call(b,opt.value); b.dispatchEvent(new Event('change',{bubbles:true})); return 'branch=Walls subtree';})()

(()=>{const tables=Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('.industry-result table')); const shown=tables[1]; const items=tables[tables.length-1]; return JSON.stringify({shownCaption:shown.querySelector('caption').textContent,itemRows:Array.from(items.querySelectorAll('tbody tr')).map(r=>r.querySelector('th')?.textContent)});})()

(()=>{const d=Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('.industry-result details')).find(x=>x.querySelector('summary')?.textContent.includes('Explore classification hierarchy')); if(!d) return 'NO HIERARCHY'; d.open=true; Array.from(d.querySelectorAll('details')).forEach(x=>x.open=true); return 'expanded hierarchy, nested details='+d.querySelectorAll('details').length;})()

(()=>{const d=Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('.industry-result details')).find(x=>x.querySelector('summary')?.textContent.includes('Explore classification hierarchy')); const out=Array.from(d.querySelectorAll('details')).map(x=>{const cap=x.querySelector('caption')?.textContent; const rows=Array.from(x.querySelectorAll('tbody tr')).map(r=>Array.from(r.querySelectorAll('th,td')).map(c=>c.textContent).join('|')); return {cap,rows};}); return JSON.stringify(out);})()

(()=>{const L=Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('.industry-result label')); const b=L.find(l=>l.textContent.trim().startsWith('Classification branch')).querySelector('select'); const set=Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(window.HTMLSelectElement.prototype,'value').set; set.call(b,''); b.dispatchEvent(new Event('change',{bubbles:true})); return 'branch=all';})()

(()=>{const setV=(el,v)=>{const set=Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(window.HTMLInputElement.prototype,'value').set; set.call(el,v); el.dispatchEvent(new Event('input',{bubbles:true}));}; const L=Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('.industry-form label')); const q=L.find(l=>l.textContent.trim().startsWith('Quantity 1')); if(!q) return 'NO QTY1'; setV(q.querySelector('input'),'0.10'); return 'edited quantity 1 to 0.10';})()
